description.en: Connects to an independently managed Antigravity ACP service. Configure its base URL and bridge key. All gateway requests execute inside the WASM component; sign in and run the CLI on the upstream service.
description.zh: 连接独立部署的 Antigravity ACP 服务，配置其地址和 Bridge 密钥。网关请求全部在 WASM 组件执行；CLI 登录与运行由上游服务管理。
